blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) on Friday said the country has applied for a global program that seeks to support developing nations in mitigating “super pollutants” through grant funding and technical assistance. In a statement, the DENR said Environment Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna had a meeting with Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) Secretariat Head Martina Otto at the United Nations Headquarters on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly. It said the “bilateral engagement provided an avenue for the Philippines to pitch its readiness for the CCAC’s Super Pollutant Country Action Accelerator (SPCAA) program for […]...
